notes: EBIT is modeled as operating income proxy = (operating margin) * revenue using the Honeywell investor fundamentals pages; this may differ slightly from management/GAAP “Operating income” disclosures due to reclassifications/restatements. ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/income-statement))

D&A is computed as depreciation (supplemental) + amortization of intangibles from the Honeywell cash flow fundamentals pages. ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/cash-flow))

Capex uses the “Capital Expenditures” line from the Honeywell cash flow fundamentals pages (absolute value). ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/cash-flow))

NWC construction (operating NWC level) = (Total current assets - cash & short-term investments) - (Total current liabilities - notes payable/short-term debt - current portion of long-term debt/capital leases). ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/balance-sheet))

Comps NTM EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA, and NTM P/E are set to null because a consistent primary/official market-data source with explicit NTM definitions was not retrieved within this run; peer tickers are provided for downstream manual fill.
NOL balance is set to null due to missing extraction of the NOL carryforward amount and jurisdictional utilization details in the materials captured in this run.

catalysts: Completion/advance of portfolio actions (assets held for sale / separation-related milestones), which can re-rate cash flows and risk. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/02/honeywell-files-annual-report-on-form-10-k-for-fiscal-year-2025))

Backlog-to-revenue conversion in aerospace and automation businesses supporting 2026 execution vs expectations. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/01/honeywell-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results-with-adjusted-sales-and-adjusted-earnings-above-high-end-of-guidance-issues-2026-outlook?utm_source=openai))
company_overview: Honeywell is an industrial technology company spanning aerospace, building automation, industrial automation, and process technologies. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/01/honeywell-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results-with-adjusted-sales-and-adjusted-earnings-above-high-end-of-guidance-issues-2026-outlook?utm_source=openai))

During 4Q25, Honeywell classified Productivity Solutions and Services (PSS) and Warehouse and Workflow Solutions (WWS) as assets held for sale as part of its portfolio optimization strategy. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/02/honeywell-files-annual-report-on-form-10-k-for-fiscal-year-2025))

Honeywell’s operating model emphasizes backlog execution and disciplined capital allocation to support mid-cycle cash generation. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/01/honeywell-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results-with-adjusted-sales-and-adjusted-earnings-above-high-end-of-guidance-issues-2026-outlook?utm_source=openai))
current_context: In its 4Q25 release, Honeywell reported record backlog of over $37B and reaffirmed/outlined 2026 outlook. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/01/honeywell-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results-with-adjusted-sales-and-adjusted-earnings-above-high-end-of-guidance-issues-2026-outlook?utm_source=openai))

Honeywell guided 2026 free cash flow (adjusted) of approximately $5.3B to $5.6B. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/01/honeywell-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results-with-adjusted-sales-and-adjusted-earnings-above-high-end-of-guidance-issues-2026-outlook?utm_source=openai))

Honeywell indicated progress on go-forward segment structure and related portfolio simplification. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/01/honeywell-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results-with-adjusted-sales-and-adjusted-earnings-above-high-end-of-guidance-issues-2026-outlook?utm_source=openai))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth assumes mid-single-digit top-line expansion supported by backlog conversion and automation demand. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/01/honeywell-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results-with-adjusted-sales-and-adjusted-earnings-above-high-end-of-guidance-issues-2026-outlook?utm_source=openai))

Base-case EBIT margin recovers from 2025 levels toward a ~16% steady-state target as costs stabilize and operating leverage returns. ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/income-statement))

Capital intensity is modeled in a 3.3% of sales range (capex as % of sales), consistent with historical capex levels. ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/cash-flow))

Working-capital intensity is modeled near ~4% of sales based on an operating NWC construction from the balance sheet. ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/balance-sheet))
key_risks: Demand cyclicality and backlog conversion risk could pressure organic growth and operating leverage. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/01/honeywell-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results-with-adjusted-sales-and-adjusted-earnings-above-high-end-of-guidance-issues-2026-outlook?utm_source=openai))

Execution risk from restructuring/portfolio optimization could create margin volatility or one-time charges. ([honeywell.com](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/press/2026/02/honeywell-files-annual-report-on-form-10-k-for-fiscal-year-2025))

Working-capital swings (trade receivables/inventory/customer advances) may diverge from the modeled ~4% of sales. ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/balance-sheet))

presentation.subtitle: Honeywell (HON) DCF Valuation Input Package
valuation_summary: DCF uses a base-case WACC of 8.5%, terminal growth of 2.0%, and an exit EV/EBITDA multiple of 16.0% to reflect mature industrial-automation earnings power.

Historical inputs (revenue, operating profitability proxy, D&A, and capex) are sourced from Honeywell’s investor financial fundamentals pages for internal consistency. ([investor.honeywell.com](https://investor.honeywell.com/financial-information/fundamentals/income-statement))
Peer comps are left partially unpopulated due to missing explicit NTM EV/Revenue and EV/EBITDA values from a primary/consistent market-data source within this run.
